items.html: Indeed, the light of these ten Nekudim was very great, and upper light was also added to them, and they had no strength to receive it; and then those vessels died. That is, they descended below, to the place that is now Beria, and this descent was their death. Indeed, this applies only to the seven lower Nekudot, for the GAR, their vessels had the strength to receive their light and they did not die; but the seven vessels of the seven lower ones, they are the ones that died and descended to the place that is now Beria, and this is their death. Indeed, the time of their death was when they came out in the secret of Nekudim. For when they came out from the secret of Akudim, that is, from their being together, included in the Keter, from where they came out and were divided into ten Nekudin, then was their emergence, and they died at once, as it is written in the Idra: “like those sparks that the craftsman strikes out of the iron, and sparks come out and are extinguished at once.”
